title: Free Career Counseling
shortDescription: One-on-one sessions to map your profile to the right course, university, and country.
description: Our certified counselors conduct a thorough assessment of your academic background, career goals, budget, and family situation before recommending the most suitable country, course, and university. Every student gets a personalised education roadmap.
processSteps: Book an appointment online or walk in
Submit your academic documents for pre-review

title: University Application Assistance
shortDescription: Complete SOP writing, LOR guidance, CV crafting, and application submission.
description: We handle the complete university application process end-to-end. Our team has placed students in 150+ partner universities globally, with direct relationships that often result in faster decisions and special admission offers.
deliverables: University shortlisting based on profile & budget
CV / Resume crafting for academic applications
Application submission to all selected universities
processSteps: Offer letter review and acceptance guidance

title: IELTS / PTE / TOEFL Coaching
shortDescription: Intensive batches with expert instructors, mock tests, and band-score guarantee.
description: Our test preparation programmes are run by experienced, certified instructors who understand exactly what examiners are looking for. We offer small batches (max 15 students), unlimited mock tests, and a band score guarantee for students who complete the full programme.
deliverables: Individual feedback on every writing task
Free re-enrollment if target not achieved
processSteps: Free diagnostic test to assess current level
Take mock tests and get individual feedback

title: Visa Assistance
shortDescription: Expert documentation, GTE/SOP drafting, financial guidance with 98% success rate.
description: Our visa team has an enviable 98% success rate across all major destinations. We meticulously prepare every aspect of your visa application — from financial affidavit structuring to mock interview coaching — ensuring the strongest possible case.
deliverables: Financial affidavit and bank statement guidance
Post-decision guidance and lodgement appeal if needed
processSteps: GTE / SOP drafting (2 rounds of editing)
Mock interview (for US F-1 and Australian visa)

title: Scholarship Guidance
shortDescription: Identify merit, need-based, and government scholarships worth up to 100% tuition.
description: Our scholarship counselors systematically identify every scholarship opportunity you are eligible for and guide you through a competitive application. We have helped students secure scholarships worth NPR crores, from Chevening to MEXT to university merit awards.
processSteps: Scholarship database search and eligibility check

title: Pre-Departure & Post-Arrival Support
shortDescription: Orientation on living costs, accommodation, banking, healthcare and more.
description: Our relationship with students does not end at the visa stamp. We organise comprehensive pre-departure orientations covering everything from packing to opening a bank account abroad, and connect students with our alumni network in their destination country.
deliverables: Introduction to local Nepali student community
Alumni network connection in destination city
orientationTopics: Packing essentials and what to leave behind
Part-time work rules and finding jobs
processSteps: Confirm travel dates and itinerary review
Get connected with alumni in your city
Ongoing support via WhatsApp alumni group
